text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nigeria's superstar Afrobeat musician Fela Anikulapo-Kuti dies.
- Community banks across Nigeria are to undergo inspection. It is thought that as many as 665 may lose their licences.
- National Fertiliser Company plans three week shutdown of its plant in Port Harcourt for maintenance.
- Head of State General Sani Abacha says Nigeria spent $3 billion on the ECOMOG peacekeeping force in Liberia during seven years of civil war.
